$comment: Single source of truth for public-facing names, domains, and URLs.
Several of these are NOT final yet. Every key listed in `_undecided` below is a
provisional placeholder — the value is real enough that builds and the docs site
work today, but it must be revisited before the v1 release.
To settle one: edit its value here, then remove its key from `_undecided`.
Run `npm run branding:check` to see what is still outstanding and to find any
hardcoded copies that need updating alongside it.
The desktop build and `npm run init -- --catalog` treat a key in `_undecided` as
absent. `moduleRepositoryUrl` is listed there because the production module host
is not serving yet: builds leave the official repository out rather than bake in
a URL that fails. Development uses the dev catalog (`npm run init:modules`, or
BIBLE_MODULE_CATALOG_URL for a desktop build).
FORKS: do not edit this file. Add `branding.local.json` beside it with only the
keys you want to change; those override the ones here. It is already gitignored
via the root `*.local.*` rule, so a rebranded fork never touches a tracked file
and never conflicts when it merges from upstream.
Every value here is locale-invariant on purpose. Translatable prose belongs in
apps/web/src/locales/<lng>/, not here -- the exception being the strings the
pre-JS HTML shell needs (title, meta description, boot splash), which are
substituted at build time by brandingPlugin() in apps/web/vite.config.ts and so
can only ever carry one language.
